name: Partnership Agreement
description: Risk checklist for partnership and joint venture agreements.

categories.name: Ownership and profit sharing
categories.description: Flag vague ownership percentages, profit sharing that can be changed unilaterally, or missing capital contribution terms.

categories.name: Decision making and control
categories.description: Flag one-sided control rights, missing voting thresholds, or no deadlock resolution process.

categories.name: Duties and non-compete
categories.description: Flag overly broad non-compete or exclusivity among partners, or missing fiduciary duty language.

categories.name: Withdrawal and dissolution
categories.description: Flag no buyout mechanism, punitive withdrawal terms, or dissolution rules that strand one party with liability.

categories.name: Liability and indemnification
categories.description: Flag unlimited personal liability, missing insurance requirements, or indemnification that covers a partner's own misconduct.
